blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On Friday, citing the need to address delays in the Philippine justice system, Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan called for the full funding of the Judiciary’s proposed ₱84.13-billion budget for 2027. The senator, who presented the Judiciary’s proposed 2027 budget, said during the upper chamber’s budget deliberations that the agency needs adequate funding […]...
